name: toast
title: Toast
description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
importSnippet:
import Toaster from "@/components/ui/toast/toast.marko";
import { toast } from "@/components/ui/toast/store.ts";
usageSnippet:
<button type="button" onClick() { toast.message({ title: "Event has been created" }); }>
  Show toast
</button>

<Toaster/>

props.name: dir
props.description:
Text direction passed to the group machine.

Typed as the full HTML `dir` surface, not just `"ltr" | "rtl"`: this Input
extends `Marko.Input<"div">`, and re-declaring `dir` more narrowly than
the attribute it inherits makes every `...rest` spread from a div-shaped
parent (e.g. `sonner.marko`) a type error. `"auto"` and the absent values
are normalized away below, since Zag's group machine accepts only the two
concrete directions.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the notification region.

props.name: toastClass
props.description:
Extra class(es) applied to every toast's root element. The zag-native
equivalent of sonner's `toastOptions.classNames.toast`. `sonner.marko`
passes the `mu-toast` style hook through here, mirroring upstream
`sonner.tsx`'s `toastOptions={{ classNames: { toast: "cn-toast" } }}`.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Call `toast.*` from anywhere in the app; a single `<Toaster/>` region renders whatever is queued.

examples.title: Types
examples.source: import Toaster from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toast/toast.marko"; import { toast } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toast/store.ts";
examples.description: Every `toast.*` helper sets the `type` used to pick the toast's icon and styling.

examples.title: With description only
examples.description: `title` is optional — a toast can carry just a `description`.

examples.title: Promise
examples.description: `toast.promise` shows a loading toast, then swaps it for the success or error toast once the promise settles.

examples.title: Dismiss all
examples.source: import Toaster from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toast/toast.marko"; import { toast } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toast/store.ts";
examples.description: `toast.dismiss()` with no id clears every toast currently on screen.
